header: The line that stands above the answer when the question used a FORMER name of a department (step 59a): "CHRD" is now called Centre for L & D (CL&D). Plain text only (React escapes it). It is not an answer and not a warning: I made it a quiet note that the name was understood and what the department is called now.

symbols.name: FormerNameNotice
symbols.sig: export function FormerNameNotice({ notice }: { notice: Notice | null })

behaviours: nothing for a question without a former name
a note (role=note) with the sentence and the history line
the sentence is the bold line, the history the small one
it is a quiet note, not a warning: sky-coloured, no red or amber
the modal computes the notice from the SEARCHED question (submittedQuery), not from the text being typed
it is drawn ABOVE the results area (and above the login hint), so it stands before any answer
it is not inside one kind of answer: the line occurs once in the modal
